spec.name: Gunblade of the Lionheart Guard
spec.description: A Final Fantasy style gunblade: a huge single-edged steel sword with a revolver chamber and trigger grip, gold filigree and a glowing cyan edge.
spec.layout: Static prop shown upright, blade pointing up (+Y), flat face toward +Z, edge on the front (+X side is the spine), centred on x=0. Grip at the bottom (y 0 to 0.3) with a pommel resting on the floor. Above the grip sits the revolver chamber assembly (y 0.3 to 0.55): trigger guard, trigger, hammer and a cylinder with six chambers and the cross guard. The blade runs from y 0.55 to 1.5, wide at the base with a broad belly, a slightly angled swept tip, a bevelled edge on -X, a thick spine on +X with a groove, fuller, gold inlay and cyan glowing runes. Style: bold angular Final Fantasy proportions, oversized blade, steel and gold trim with royal blue cloth and a lion-motif emblem repeated on pommel, guard and blade base. Every piece is a flat colour part, layered as dark outline, main colour, then highlight.

parts.builds: Handle and pommel: leather-wrapped octagonal grip with royalBlue cloth bands and gold ferrules, a faceted gold pommel with a lion emblem and a small red gem, a dangling short tassel in royalBlue with gold beads at the pommel, rests on the floor.
parts.attaches: Top meets the chamber at gripTop; pommel base at pommelBase.

parts.builds: Revolver mechanism: a six-chambered cylinder in chamberMetal with gold rim rings and dark chamber holes, bullet tips in gold, a trigger, curved trigger guard, hammer, a barrel-like housing of steelDark, rivets and gold filigree plates, and a small glowing cyan indicator. Sits between the grip and the guard.
parts.attaches: Bottom at gripTop, top at guardLine; the blade tang passes through it.

parts.builds: Cross guard and ornament: swept gold winged guard with layered outline, main and highlight pieces, a royalBlue cloth inlay, a central lion-head emblem, small spikes and gems in red, and chained feather charms hanging from the guard sides.
parts.attaches: Sits on guardLine, overlapping the chamber top and the blade base.

parts.builds: The huge single-edged blade: a thick steel body with a swept angled tip, a lighter bevelled edge on the -X side, a steelDark spine on +X with stepped notches, a central fuller groove, gold inlay lines, cyan glowing rune marks and an edge glow strip, small cut-outs and a lion emblem at the base, plus rivets along the spine.
parts.attaches: Base at bladeBase on the guard; the tip at bladeTip.
